summary: This document is a roadmap for a biotech project focused on autonomous AI-driven peptide drug design targeting GPCRs (KISS1R, OX2R, GLP-1R) using non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs). It outlines planned milestones from Q2 2026 through Q2 2027, spanning computational design, wet-lab validation, autonomous iteration, pipeline expansion beyond GPCRs, lead optimization, and first in vivo studies. No experimental results are reported; all milestones are future-planned.

content_blocks.title: Roadmap Overview
content_blocks.content: The document presents a phased development roadmap from Q2 2026 to Q2 2027 for an autonomous AI-driven drug discovery pipeline targeting GPCRs and beyond. Key themes include: computational design and wet-lab validation of peptide candidates incorporating non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs), on-chain data attestation via Molecule Labs, autonomous design-test-iterate cycles, and progressive expansion to non-GPCR targets. No experimental results are reported; all milestones are planned future events.

content_blocks.title: Q2 2026 Milestones
content_blocks.content:
1. KISS1R + OX2R leads ready for wet-lab: Lead candidates designed and computationally validated. Wet-lab synthesis orders placed.
2. First on-chain wet-lab attestation: Binding affinity data published on Molecule Labs. Every assay timestamped on-chain.

Current TRL implication: Candidates are at computational design/validation stage (TRL 1-2). Wet-lab synthesis is ordered but not yet completed. Binding affinity assays are planned but not yet executed.

content_blocks.title: Q3 2026 Milestones
content_blocks.content:
1. Design vs. nature: comparative validation — ncAA candidates benchmarked head-to-head against natural references. bioRxiv preprint follows.
2. Autonomous iteration cycle proven — Wet-lab data feeds back into design. Generation 2 candidates produced without human intervention.
3. GLP-1R Generation 1 library — First de novo GLP-1R agonists designed end-to-end through the autonomous pipeline. Wet-lab queued.

TRL implication: Comparative binding assays against natural references planned (TRL 2-3 transition). Autonomous feedback loop to be demonstrated. GLP-1R is a new target entering the pipeline.

content_blocks.title: Q4 2026 Milestones
content_blocks.content:
Pipeline scales beyond GPCRs: Non-GPCR target enters pipeline. CRO partnerships expanded. Receptor-agnostic claim validated.

TRL implication: Platform generalizability claim to be validated experimentally. CRO partnership expansion indicates outsourced wet-lab capacity scaling.

content_blocks.title: Q1 2027 Milestones
content_blocks.content:
Lead optimization at scale: Top candidates enter ncAA optimization with PK characterization. Pre-IND scoping initiated.

TRL implication: PK characterization and pre-IND scoping represent a transition toward TRL 3-4. This is the first regulatory-adjacent activity mentioned.

content_blocks.title: Q2 2027 Milestones
content_blocks.content:
Multi-target portfolio in vivo: First in vivo studies on lead candidates. Cross-target portfolio progressing in parallel.

TRL implication: First in vivo studies would represent TRL 3 (disease-model validation in animals). This is the most advanced planned milestone in the document.

key_findings: All milestones are future-planned; no experimental results have been reported yet — project is currently at TRL 1-2 (computational design stage).
Targets include KISS1R, OX2R (Q2 2026), and GLP-1R (Q3 2026); pipeline planned to expand to non-GPCR targets by Q4 2026.
Lead candidates for KISS1R and OX2R are described as computationally designed and validated, with wet-lab synthesis orders placed — no binding affinity data yet available.
Binding affinity assays are planned for Q2 2026, with on-chain attestation via Molecule Labs.
Comparative validation of ncAA candidates vs. natural references (head-to-head benchmarking) planned for Q3 2026, with a bioRxiv preprint to follow.
Autonomous design-test-iterate cycle (Generation 2 candidates without human intervention) planned for Q3 2026.
PK characterization and pre-IND scoping planned for Q1 2027.
First in vivo studies planned for Q2 2027 — this would be the first TRL 3 evidence.
CRO partnerships are planned to be expanded by Q4 2026.
Non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs) are a core technology differentiator for lead optimization.
